app.title: Show HN: I built a little browser game to practice Vim commands
app.author: dh1011
app.description: A lightweight browser-based game that teaches Vim navigation keys through interactive gameplay.
proposed_tests: Load the game page and verify the start screen appears.
Simulate key presses for 'h', 'j', 'k', 'l' and check the cursor moves accordingly.
Attempt to complete a level and ensure the score updates correctly.
Measure page load time and compare against a baseline of 2000 ms.
